newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan headmaster abused 117 girls, says newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan headmaster abused 117 girls, says newspaper.

text.p: A Moroccan school headmaster has been suspended on suspicion of sexually abusing 117 girls aged between eight and 12, the daily newspaper al-Bayane said on Tuesday.
It said the man had been a teacher for 34 years and was headmaster in a school near Ouarzazate in southern Morocco.

Al-Bayane said the story was disclosed after a young girl, asked by her teacher to fetch chalk from the headmaster's office, refused. The teacher questioned the child at the end of the class and she said that she had been abused.
The teacher told other colleagues who checked with other children, and discovered similar allegations.
The education ministry was alerted and investigated the complaints. The headmaster was suspended in April but remains free and has not been charged, the newspaper said.
It added that according to parents more than 30 girls left the school during the last two years because of alleged sexual abuses.
